marco (SRE): Heads up — scheduled rolling AZ maintenance this Sat 02:00-04:00 UTC. Well be doing a live rollout on edge pools + a coordinated KV-cache warmup. Expect short tail-latency blips and brief 5-10% elevated 5xx rate on a small subset of routes.

kavita: Is this the one that touches the legacy edge (edge-v1) and new edge-v2?

marco (SRE): Yes — both. Plan: drain 1 AZ at a time, rotate edge-v1 then edge-v2, run pre-warm traffic to populate KV cache before we move traffic back. No planned full downtime.

emily-product: Will Dedicated/Dedicated-reserved customers be affected? any SLA exceptions?

marco (SRE): Short answer: minimal. Dedicated capacity stays pinned, but cross-region routing could see tiny error spikes when we move traffic. Were declaring a temporary SLO adjustment window in the console for Sat 02:00-05:00 UTC for internal reporting only (no customer invoice changes).

alex_oncall: Ill own pagers for the window. Im going to raise the 5xx alert threshold by 20% and add a slack-alert to this channel.

rei-ops: Running the warmup job configuration now — using 10 qps canary across ~5% of requests to seed KV cache. Job id: warmup-2026-03-27-1

sre-bot: Canary job warmup-2026-03-27-1 started by rei-ops. Logs: https://internal.corp/logs/warmup-2026-03-27-1

marco (SRE): Procedure notes (short):
- Step 1: Drain AZ using drain script: `./tools/drain-az.sh us-west-2a --grace 60`
- Step 2: Run warmup canary: `python infra/warmup.py --job warmup-2026-03-27-1`
- Step 3: Monitor traces & tail-latency dashboard, allow 10m stabilization before promoting traffic

(put the above in the maintenance doc: https://confluence.redwood/eng/sre/az-maint-2026-03-27)

kavita: Throwing in a reminder — ensure autoscaler cooldowns are disabled for the edge autoscaler in that window, or we'll get churn.

marco (SRE): Good catch. Ive updated the maintenance doc and turned off autoscaler scaling actions for edge pools for the window.

emily-product: If we see larger-than-expected regressions, what's rollback?

marco (SRE): Rollback plan: immediate re-route to secondary region using routing-policy `fast-fallback`, revert any cache TTL changes, and (if needed) abort the AZ drain. Full runbook is section 4 in the maintenance doc.

alex_oncall: Ill be at my desk. Slack pager is on. Will post live status updates every 15m during the window.

rei-ops: Will also run a quick smoke test after each AZ is back: `curl -sS https://edge-redwood.example/health | jq .`

marco (SRE): Thanks all. If you want to join the war-room during the window, Ill open a call 01:55 UTC. Ping me and Ill add you. :thumbsup:

kavita: ack :thumbsup:

emily-product: thanks — will let support know to expect possible transient errors and to escalate to oncall if customers report issues.

sre-bot: Reminder scheduled: maintenance window starting in 24h for rolling AZ maintenance (1799876543).
